name: UMass Amherst Pre-College Summer Programs
org: University of Massachusetts Amherst, University Without Walls
city: Amherst, MA (also online and the UMass Charles River Campus in Boston)
what_you_do: Take a faculty-led summer course for high school students in over 25 topics like STEM, art and design, and business. A six-week lab research option is also offered.
grades: Rising sophomores, juniors and seniors (some programs only juniors and seniors)
who_can_apply: Rising sophomores, juniors and seniors in high school, and seniors who just graduated. The Pre-Veterinary Medicine and Veterinary Technology programs are only for rising juniors and seniors.
pay_detail: $45 application fee. Listed fees: 2-week programs $4,119 residential or $2,337 commuter; 3-week $6,125 or $3,397; 6-week Research Intensives $12,813 or $7,247. Some programs add a $95 materials fee. Limited need-based partial scholarships (up to $1,000) for 1 to 3 week programs.
duration: 1 to 6 weeks, depending on the program
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed (2026 deadlines were May 1 extended to May 15, May 15 and May 31 by start date). Research Intensives 2026 deadlines were March 15, extended to April 15. The site says Summer 2027 program details and applications will be available in January.
how_to_apply: Sign up for updates on the Pre-College page now. Applications for 2027 open in January. They are reviewed on a rolling basis. Scholarship applications use the same online system.
notes: Expensive. This is a college course experience, not a job. The page also lists year-round college prep workshops (fall 2026 workshops are open).
